item.title: Spotify Adds AI Persona Badges to Clarify Artists
item.description: Spotify will label generative‑AI music accounts with an AI Persona badge, adding transparency, an appeal process, and exclusion from recommendations.

item.title: Spotify Flags AI-Generated Artists with New Badge Policy
item.description: Spotify will tag non‑human creators with an “AI Persona” badge and remove their tracks from recommendation feeds starting mid‑September, boosting transparency for listeners
